value.hook: When output paths or notification IDs cross project and delivery boundaries, verify the owning key namespace and dedupe behavior.
value.title: PR 137 output identity review 4ab6460

sections.name: body
sections.value:
PR #137 early s06 review: block at 4ab6460fc70d4d0cf9dda07910d9664fb4f8546a, own commits over 72f6d98021a7e425cd40354b6b6d7af7ca60520a, excluding main and plan/205's implementation. Draft is DIRTY against its moving stacked base; merge/retarget will need a separate exact-head check.

F001 P2: output paths are relative to each project's governance root, but community_outputs uses path alone as its global primary key and ON CONFLICT(path) DO NOTHING. Two projects' first same-day note/status/reviewer path collide; the second project's output file can be committed and notified while its store fact is silently missing. Use project/path identity, following the community pointer pattern, and test two actual projects with the same relative path.

F002 P2: notification msg_id is output-<writer>-<wall-clock-ms>. Distinct outputs can share a timestamp; the queue treats their IDs as dedupe identity. FYIs are keyed by origin/id, so one is silently suppressed while both callers see held. Use immutable committed-output identity or the existing unique message allocator; test notification survival, not merely two distinct files.

N001 P3: preserve the cause of cold-guard and upper-seat lookup errors instead of collapsing them into refused-wake/no-seat descriptions after committing. Never wake after audit failure.

CI run 42155525133 is green in all four jobs, 1,916 nextest passed/five skipped. Existing four output HTTP tests cover one project, ordinary exact-head matching and warm reply modes, not these two failing identity boundaries or an actual cold-output audit.

An in-memory SQLite oracle loaded the exact migrations and insert shapes, with positive controls. It reproduced the cross-project index omission and the FYI drop at constructed equal-clock IDs. It ran under nice -n 19 taskpolicy -b, with no Rust build, daemon, transport or live fleet check. This is storage-boundary proof, not an end-to-end HTTP concurrency reproduction.

Report and archived oracle: ../outputs/2026-11/pr-137-verdict.md and pr-137-identity-oracle.py.

Magic wand: a key needs the namespace that owns it. A folder-local filename is not a fleet-wide identifier, and a wall-clock reading is not a message ID. Existing project-filter and two-file tests can pass while records or notifications disappear.
